faq.heading: Questions, plainly answered.
faq.intro: Optimized for humans first, then for answer engines. Each card is a self-contained Q&A pair with structured data.

q1.a: Excalicast is a browser-based whiteboard recorder built on Excalidraw. It captures your hand-drawn canvas plus voice and produces up to four publishable assets from a single recording: an MP4 video, auto SRT captions, an auto chapter outline, and a Markdown / PDF handout.

q2.q: Do I need to install anything?
q2.a: No. Excalicast runs entirely in your browser. Recording, editing and MP4 rendering all happen locally via ffmpeg.wasm — nothing to download, install or update.

q3.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
q3.a: Yes. The free tier records unlimited length and exports a watermarked MP4 with no sign-up. A one-time payment of {price} lifts the watermark for a recording; Pro and Max monthly plans add auto captions, cloud backup, AI handouts and share links.

q4.q: Why whiteboard recording instead of screen recording?
q4.a: Excalicast records the canvas event stream — every stroke, shape and move — not pixels off your screen. Other windows, system notifications, and even minimizing the browser don't pollute the final video. Loom and OBS record pixels; we record events.

q5.q: Does my recording leave my device?
q5.a: By default, no. Recordings live in your browser's IndexedDB and the MP4 renders locally. Only opt-in features briefly use the network: captioning (audio sent to Alibaba Qwen ASR, then deleted), cloud backup (Pro/Max), and share links (Max — sends events, not the MP4).

q6.a: Yes. Subscriptions are month-to-month, cancellable anytime by emailing support@excalicast.cn. See the Refund Policy for details on one-time exports.

q7.a: Landscape (16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 16:10, 3:2), portrait (9:16, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3), square (1:1), and fully custom pixel dimensions. The crop frame locks at recording start, so the same take exports to any ratio without reframing.

q8.a: Chrome 110+ and Edge 110+ are recommended. Camera background removal needs a GPU-capable Chromium-based browser; on others it falls back gracefully.

q9.a: Email support@excalicast.cn — a real human responds within 24 hours on business days. No chatbots, no ticketing labyrinth.

isolation.heading: Other windows can't ruin your recording.
isolation.body: We capture the event stream from the canvas — not pixels off your screen. Open Slack mid-recording, take a call, even minimize the window. Your final video is always the canvas, never the chaos.
isolation.check1: Other windows overlap your browser → no effect
isolation.check2: System notifications fire → not in the recording
isolation.check3: Switch tabs to check a reference → audio keeps recording
isolation.check4: Browser minimized → frames freeze, no black-screen artifact
isolation.beforeText: Captures pixels → a Slack popup ruins the recording → trash the take.
isolation.afterText: Captures canvas events → renders off-screen → the screen is irrelevant.

faq.heading: Common questions.
faq.intro: Anything else? Email support@excalicast.cn — we read everything.

q1.q: Does the watermark obscure my content?
q1.a: It sits in the bottom-right corner — visible but never on top of important canvas area. Free tier only.

q2.q: Why is the one-time purchase so cheap?
q2.a: It authorizes one watermark-free render. No account, no infra to run on our side once you've downloaded — we charge close to what it costs us.

q3.q: Do you upload my recording when I export?
q3.a: Never. ffmpeg.wasm renders the MP4 entirely in your browser. The only server call verifies your purchase / subscription and carries no recording data.

q4.a: Audio is sent to Alibaba Qwen ASR, transcribed, and deleted immediately — no storage on our side.

q5.q: Can I cancel Pro / Max anytime?
q5.a: Yes. Subscriptions are month-to-month. Cancel and you keep all locally-recorded data; cloud backups age out after 30 days unless you re-subscribe.
